title: SUSTUNO Dye Shade ML Feature Schema
description: Versioned feature schema for supervised dye shade prediction model (predicting actual measured L*a*b* from material, dye recipe, chemical recipe, and process parameters).

fiber_composition.name: fiber_composition
fiber_composition.definition: Fiber blend breakdown of the fabric substrate (e.g., 'cotton-100', 'polyester-65-cotton-35')
fiber_composition.reason_for_inclusion: Fiber type dictates dye affinity, exhaustion rate, and color yield.

fabric_type.name: fabric_type
fabric_type.reason_for_inclusion: Fabric structure affects liquor pickup, surface reflectance, and apparent shade depth.

gsm.name: gsm
gsm.definition: Grams per square meter of fabric
gsm.reason_for_inclusion: Fabric density influences dye penetration and light absorption characteristics.

fabric_weight_kg.name: fabric_weight_kg
fabric_weight_kg.definition: Total dry fabric weight loaded into the dyeing vessel
fabric_weight_kg.reason_for_inclusion: Determines total dye liquor volume and chemical dosing requirements.

dye_class.name: dye_class
dye_class.reason_for_inclusion: Fundamental chemical mechanism governing fixation and chromaticity.

dyes.name: dyes
dyes.definition: List of dyes in recipe with concentrations
dyes.reason_for_inclusion: Direct colorant inputs responsible for spectral absorption across visible wavelengths.

chemicals.name: chemicals
chemicals.definition: List of auxiliary chemicals (alkali, salt, leveling agents) in recipe
chemicals.reason_for_inclusion: Auxiliaries control bath pH, ionic strength, dye solubility, and fixation efficiency.

liquor_ratio.name: liquor_ratio
liquor_ratio.definition: Ratio of liquor volume (liters) to fabric dry weight (kg)
liquor_ratio.reason_for_inclusion: Determines bath dye concentration and equilibrium dye uptake.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.reason_for_inclusion: Controls diffusion rate, kinetic energy, and covalent bonding rate of dye molecules.

time_minutes.name: time_minutes
time_minutes.definition: Total dyeing duration at peak temperature
time_minutes.reason_for_inclusion: Determines extent of dye exhaustion and levelness.

ph.name: ph
ph.definition: Measured dye bath pH during fixation stage
ph.reason_for_inclusion: Critical for cellulosics reactive dye fixation and protein fiber dye absorption.

machine_type.name: machine_type
machine_type.definition: Dyeing machine vessel category or model
machine_type.reason_for_inclusion: Vessel hydrodynamics, liquor circulation speed, and mechanical action impact levelness.

measured_L.name: measured_L
measured_L.definition: Spectrophotometer-measured lightness of resulting dyed fabric
